cohort: Pregnant women without maternal comorbidities referred for outpatient antenatal testing for gestational age ≥40 weeks
finding: There was no significant difference in the rate of abnormal antenatal testing results or adverse birth outcomes between women tested at 40 weeks and those tested at 41 weeks.
mod_finding: The study found no significant differences in rates of labor induction or mode of delivery between pregnancies tested at 40 weeks and those tested at 41 weeks.
